mentions.name: Human-first publishing platform
mentions.description: A publishing platform designed to counter current industry trends: it enforces strictly human-written content, uses pagination instead of endless feeds, offers one-off payments instead of subscriptions, defaults to a linear feed, and uses public profile scoring instead of secretive recommendation algorithms.
mentions.problem: Aims to go against the tide of endless feeds, subscription models, and secretive algorithms on publishing platforms.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am building on a publishing platform that aims to go against some of the tide.

Strictly human content, pagination instead of endless feeds, one-off payments instead of subscriptions, linear feed by default, public profile scoring instead of secretive algorithms.
